Use case: precise-object-edit / production website asset.
Input is the approved desktop homepage visual reference. Extract and faithfully rebuild ONLY the dimensional orange-and-cobalt exhibition screen structure on the right, as a standalone isolated 3D website compositing asset.
TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND outside the object. No webpage, no words, no captions, no buttons, no text, no numbers, no branding, no cartoon host/girl. No film content inside the screen.
The result is the physical display theatre from the reference: thick bevelled orange frame, dark recessed inner screen bezel, thick cobalt rear architectural panel with clearly visible right-side depth, THREE mounted black cylindrical spotlights casting warm light, the orange thick solid plinth/base and its side return, small film reels and a paper stack at lower left, and the physical blank ivory results plaque across the lower front. Leave this plaque completely blank and easily overlaid with live HTML numbers, with simple straight usable edges.
The central screen aperture must be a completely featureless flat very dark charcoal rectangle/polygon (#151719), not an illustrated scene; real HTML video will be composited above it. Make the screen large and clean, four corners clearly readable, near-frontal with a gentle upward right slope on the top edge and nearly level lower edge. Do not add reflections or objects crossing the inner screen. The inner aperture should take about68% of total object width and45% of total object height.
The overall orange solid frame, cobalt panel, spotlight arrangement, grounded perspective, warm studio lighting, matte lacquer, bevel highlights, contact shadows and premium tangible 3D volume must closely match the reference. No new scenery. The left reels are real matte metal, the small paper stack shows subtle paper layers. The small sketch-frame prop may be a blank ivory frame, no drawing or person. Strong consistent front/middle/back ordering.
Composition: object fully visible with a small transparent margin, centered on a landscape canvas around1600x1150. Base resting along bottom, no cropping of lights, reels, panel or plinth. Preserve the reference's camera angle and saturated orange/cobalt palette. Add no background room, wall, floor or border; only subtle transparent cast shadow immediately beneath object. High-quality production-ready isolated 3D structure suitable to combine with separate DOM screen, DOM stats plaque, and independent character cutout. No baked UI.

Use case: identity-preserve / production website character sticker.
Generate ONE standalone transparent-background illustrated sheep-girl host cutout for an existing website. Image 1 is the APPROVED HOMEPAGE COMPOSITION and is the authoritative reference for the character's POSE, BODY ORIENTATION, EXPRESSION, illustrated style and proportions: reproduce the flat illustrated sheep girl standing at the extreme right edge of the orange theatre. Image 2 is supporting identity/detail reference only; its horizontal flying pose is explicitly WRONG for the requested asset and MUST NOT be copied.

Critical request: recreate the character from the right-hand side of Image 1 as a high-resolution independent image, not a website screenshot. She is a TALL UPRIGHT or SLIGHTLY LEFT-LEANING welcoming host, standing with her feet down on the stage, peeking out from beside the screen. Her body is vertical, NOT flying, NOT swimming, NOT kicking out horizontally. Her left arm extends toward the viewer and slightly left, with a welcoming open palm and clear foreshortening; five naturally drawn fingers. Her other arm bends up behind/above the head, holding a black drawing pencil. This must feel like the lively, welcoming standing pose from Image 1. Head and torso occupy the upper two thirds. Lower legs remain short and vertical. Include the complete figure, black pleated skirt, bare knees, simple blue-and-white sneakers. Keep all hands, pencil, scarf ends, horns, and feet inside the canvas with a little transparent breathing room.

Identity: exactly the same charming girl mascot: fluffy WHITE curly sheep hair, two small ivory curved horns, pointed sheep ears with pink interiors, warm light peach skin, large amber-brown expressive eyes BOTH OPEN as in Image 1, little freckles, a joyful open-mouth smile, vivid cobalt oversized chunky sweater with the small existing white pixel-outline emblem, warm ORANGE knitted scarf with small fringes hanging near her torso. Preserve clean confident black comic outlines and delicate colored pencil/ink texture. Keep the orange scarf compact, draping down/right behind her, not a giant horizontal flying tail. The reaching hand is expressive but must not dominate or obscure her face. Character family must match Image 1, not become a new 3D doll.

Style: polished 2D hand-drawn full-color editorial manga illustration, flat colored fills with modest illustrated shading. Thin warm ivory die-cut edge around the silhouette, approximately 3px at final display size, with a subtle dark outer cut edge only. The WHITE hair must be visibly ivory-white, not transparent. Real alpha transparency around the figure, including between fingers and arms. No opaque checkerboard, no solid background.

Composition: portrait cutout roughly 2:3 aspect ratio, upright full figure, largest usable resolution. Figure fills most of the canvas. Designed to sit to the RIGHT of a solid orange and cobalt 3D screen, with palm overlapping that screen's lower right corner. Do NOT include the screen, theatre, orange base, scenery, numeric plaque, illustration frame, typography, logos other than the original tiny sweater emblem, reaction marks, sparkles, extra props or extra characters. Do not bake a floor or cast shadow into the transparency; the web page will provide placement and shadow. Return only the ONE finished transparent character asset.
